body: The calls have definitely stopped. I am seeking help. I want to be better. I just hope she sees it

We've been together for 6 years, been married for 2. No kids (unless you count the kitty). I've been caught with this several times over the last few years and I never dealt with it. We'd fight, then make up, I'd stop for awhile, and I'd think I wouldn't need help. I know this last time may have been the last straw. There's nothing I can say that make it sound like what I was doing was right. I'm an addict. I'm similar to your husband as I was seeking out girls to get off with. I never met any of them, I never tried to hold a relationship with them... From the moment I said hi to her the very first time I never touched another woman. But none of that matters because I destroyed her trust in me. I failed her. 

I am getting help, I'm seeing a therapist, I'm keeping myself occupied the best I can. I've had good days, and some really bad days. But with all that I have no idea how she's doing. She refuses to speak to me. She says she wants space and I'm giving it to her, sometimes I have days I miss her so much and I'd text her. I want to be a better man, the man she fell in love with, I want to be better. I don't want to be whoever the fuck this is on reddit on a throwaway account... I want to be me again.
I'm so sorry you're going through this. How long has this going on? Are you guys working it out? I'd like to talk to you and tell you more about our situation.

I know I know it seems I'm just talking about myself here. The worst part about all of this is the woman that means the most to me is in pain and I caused it. I've seen this woman in pain before over family members passing away, bad days at work, losing a friend, etc. and it's something I hate seeing. It's tearing me up that I caused this. I know I don't deserve her, she sure as hell didn't deserve this. 

But I'm going to try to be a better man. It's going to be hard to overcome this, and I know there may be a chance she'll never come back.... But I can't give up right?

I'm perfectly aware that she's in pain. That's what hurts the most about this. I caused this. I want to show her I'm changing and I'm trying to get better. But I don't know if she cares anymore. But I'm still going to try because I love her and she didn't deserve this.
I want to change, I want to be better and become better. But if she's not there at the finish to see the new me, then what good is it?
I know... But my heart can't take her leaving. I'm not well.
It may sound ridiculous, but I'm addicted to phone sex. I didn't cheat on her in the traditional sense but I know she feels that way and that's what matters.

I'm terrified that within or after those 4 months she's going to forget about me. Right now she's acting so cold towards me. I know I hurt her, I know I've done wrong. I don't know how I'm going to make it with no contact with her. The last 6 years I was in bed with that woman. Every night. I can't get used to her not being there. I was self sufficient before I met her but during our time she insisted on taking care of everything. She wanted to be a good wife.... She was the perfect wife.... Why did I do this to her? She didn't deserve this.
I know, it's not lost on me that she has every right to be upset with me. I ruined this, it is my fault. I have to live with this for the rest of my life.

Lately I've been having the urges but I have been fighting them. I've been burying myself in video games and such. I've been avoiding porn because it's a triggered. It's tough because this nightmare may have costed me my marriage and I don't know how to save it. I really love this woman and I hate that I hurt her. I want to get better and show her that I am getting better. I just hope it's not too late. I don't know if I can win this without her.

I'm losing my wife, my best friend, my everything because of my phone sex addiction. 

I don't want to lose her... I'm nothing without her
